IC1: Patients with a histologically [OR] or cytologically proven diagnosis of NSCLC
IC2: Unresectable (locally advanced) stage IIIa [OR] or IIIb disease
IC3: Initial radiotherapy field of treatment to encompass greater than [OR] or equal to 30% of the esophagus
IC4: Life expectancy greater than [OR] or equal to 6 months
IC5: Estimated weight loss less than [OR] or equal to 10% in the 3 months before study randomization
IC8: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 - 2
IC9: Hemoglobin (hgb) greater than [OR] or equal to 10 g/dL [NOT] without transfusional support [OR] or growth factor use in the 4 weeks before study randomization
IC10: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) greater than [OR] or equal to 1.5 x 10^9/L [NOT] without growth factor use in the 2 weeks before study randomization
IC11: Platelet count greater than [OR] or equal to 100 x 10^9/L
IC12: Serum bilirubin less than [OR] or equal to 1.5 x institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)
IC13: Serum creatinine less than or equal to 2.0 mg/dL [OR] (Note: Patients with a serum creatinine greater than [OR] or equal to 1.4 and less than [OR] or equal to 2.0 mg/dL must demonstrate a 24-hour urinary creatinine clearance greater than [OR] or equal to 50 mL/min)
IC14: Females [AND] of childbearing potential: negative serum [OR] or urine pregnancy test
IC15: Patient must give written informed consent before participating in any study-specific [OR] procedure [OR], randomization [OR], or receiving investigational product.
IC16: Patients with reproductive capability [AND] must agree to practice adequate contraception methods.
